name: How quickly should I schedule a storm damage inspection after a storm?

mainEntity.name: How quickly should I schedule a storm damage inspection after a storm?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should schedule a storm damage inspection as soon as safely possible after a severe weather event, ideally within a few days. Many insurance policies have deadlines for reporting storm damage, often within 1-2 years, but early reporting can streamline the claims process and prevent secondary damage. Discounted Roofing Co. recommends contacting us within 24-48 hours of a significant storm to ensure a timely assessment and documentation before hidden problems worsen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule an inspection within days of a storm; early reporting aids insurance claims and prevents worsening damage.
